problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.
latest_diagnosis: The laptop is still using cached old credentials for the campus Wi-Fi (eduroam), which are invalid after the password change. The phone likely updated successfully or used a different authentication method.
proposed_solution: Go to Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi, select 'eduroam', and choose 'Forget' to clear cached credentials.
Reconnect to 'eduroam' and enter your updated university username and password (double-check for typos).
Restart Wi-Fi on the laptop by disabling and re-enabling it to refresh the connection.
